# Sample Data Directory

Place UDISE+ CSV files here before running `python data/setup_bq.py`.

## Required files

- `udise_nandurbar.csv` — Download from [udiseplus.gov.in](https://udiseplus.gov.in) → Data Summary → Nandurbar District

## Generated files (after setup)

- `teachers_synth.csv` — Generated by `python data/gen_teachers.py`

## Note

These files are gitignored — never commit real UDISE data to version control.
